verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for LangSmith, which includes an automation layer and agent deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows event-driven automation: rules, webhooks, online evaluators that run automatically on incoming production traces, and threshold-based alerts. None of these is a documented recurring or time-based schedule, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
